projects.title: Stream Chat Swift (Production Realtime Messaging)
projects.description: Production-grade open-source chat client supporting WebSockets, Combine state binding, offline CoreData persistence, and SwiftUI views. Demonstrates realtime messaging architecture with modular components.

projects.title: Firebase iOS SDK (Realtime Database & Firestore)
projects.description: Production-grade SDK for realtime data synchronization with Cloud Firestore and Realtime Database. Includes offline persistence, Combine integration, and SwiftUI support. Ideal for learning cloud-backed realtime architectures.

projects.title: Socket.IO Client Swift (Realtime WebSocket Communication)
projects.description: Production-grade WebSocket client library for realtime bidirectional communication. Supports rooms, namespaces, custom events, and automatic reconnection. A lightweight foundation for building custom realtime features.

projects.title: Interactive Portfolio with Embedded Game
projects.description: Build a personal portfolio website that showcases your projects and includes a playable game (e.g., memory match, snake, or simple platformer) embedded directly into the page. The portfolio will be fully responsive and the game will be built with vanilla JavaScript or a lightweight library like Phaser. This project demonstrates front-end development skills, interactive design, and game logic implementation.
key_features: Responsive portfolio layout with project cards and about section
Embedded interactive game (e.g., memory match, snake, or simple platformer)
Deployed on GitHub Pages or Netlify

projects.title: Build a Rust CLI Tool for File Processing
projects.description: A command-line tool that processes files (e.g., search, replace, count lines, etc.) using Rust's standard library and popular crates like clap for argument parsing. The project will teach file I/O, error handling, and CLI design.
key_features: Output results to stdout or file
